verdict.rationale: The evidence shows that the collection ships a TDD skill that teaches agents to write failing tests first in users' projects. That is an adjacent feature, not evidence that the collection maintains tests or evals for its own skills to catch regressions. Nothing in the pack documents an eval suite, CI checks, or regression testing of the SKILL.md files, so this applicable axis has no supporting evidence.

support.subject: As a developer, the collection maintains tests or evals for its skills so changes are verified against regressions rather than shipped on vibes
